card.name: The letter b before "urning" and similar
card.fires_on: The lone letter b (often after a space or hyphen, or after a slash) that starts a word such as burning, as in "stinging/burning" or "fuel-burning". It also fires on capital B starting words like Bacterial or Bittern.
